notes:
Nashama TV iOS v1.1.9:
- Settings: added a working Check for Update button; removed the non-functional Parental Lock PIN and Restore Hidden Categories entries.
- Attempted fix for channel/poster logos rendering as gray placeholders: image requests now send the same User-Agent header stream playback already uses, in case the provider's static-asset host blocks the default request headers.
- Install with Sideloadly or xtool using your Apple ID; re-sideload every 7 days to keep it signed.
